About inCommon
inCommon is a space for self-reflection. It brings astrology, Human Design, numerology and other reflective traditions together with a private journal, so you can look at your own patterns over time and notice what you hold in common with the people around you. Your experience is the final authority. Here, everyone has something in common.

inCommon is a space for self-reflection. It brings astrology, Human Design, numerology and other reflective traditions together with a private journal, so you can look at your own patterns over time and notice what you hold in common with the people around you. Your experience is the final authority. Here, everyone has something in common.
